title: Terminal inverse-image restriction for an etale object
statement: For a sheaf of sets H on R [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] and U in the small etale site of R [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], define the isomorphism from H(U) to the terminal sections of the inverse image of H along U to R. Its data is restriction along the opposite of the canonical identity-underlying-scheme isomorphism from the terminal object over U postcomposed to R to U, followed by the inverse of the chosen etale inverse-image/restriction isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-restriction] at the terminal object.
